classifications.reason: Synchronously owns and restores bounded request bytes, endpoint URLs, bearer strings, evaluation time, and timeout, then constructs all four private Request objects with captured URL, Request, AbortSignal, and fetch capabilities before suspension. Redirects are denied and captured Response/stream-reader operations bound every body. The result verifies exact roles and identities, a signer-approved origin/key challenge binding, both canonical signature responses, and final dual-signed evidence before returning a detached token-free replay bundle.

Synchronously owns and restores one bounded signing request, one endpoint URL and bearer string, the exact role, and timeout; verifies that the role-local endpoint origin is already bound into the signed challenge; and constructs both captured identity and signature Requests before suspension. It bounds both responses, requires the live role/key and canonical signature response to match the request, and returns one detached token-free role-response artifact. It cannot invoke or finalize the other role.

Synchronously owns and restores the exact bounded plan, verifies the observer identity is in its complete roster, snapshots the durable signer capability, derives the exact acceptance ID and ceremony-scoped sign-once tuple, and invokes the captured signer before suspension. After suspension it verifies the returned key and Ed25519 signature. The tuple permits exact retry but rejects a second plan for the same ceremony under that observer key; this is pre-observation plan agreement, not roster or topology authority.

Synchronously owns the exact bounded HTTPS observation, Capsule, complete supplied membership-epoch candidate view, and membership-bound all-roster activation; re-runs membership convergence, requires the artifact's exact candidate-view commitment and selected current epoch, checks the admitted complete observer roster and declaration digests, verifies the assigned observer and observation window, snapshots the signer, derives the v5 attestation ID, and invokes the captured signer before its first suspension through one plan-scoped durable sign-once tuple. Exact attestation retry is idempotent, while a different membership view, observation, or attestation instant under the same accepted plan halts as equivocation. After suspension it verifies the returned key and Ed25519 signature before returning detached canonical bytes; omitted hidden candidates, physical independence, and absolute Sybil resistance remain unproven.

Synchronously owns the exact membership artifact, current Capsule, complete supplied membership-epoch candidate bytes, times, observer capability, optional bounded possession authorizations, and a journal publication capability; requires deterministic candidate-view convergence to the artifact's selected current epoch, then verifies the exact ceremony evidence, admitted all-observer assignment, nonce, declaration digests, timeout, and window before network access and starts the captured HTTPS observation boundary before its first suspension. After the probe succeeds it requires the captured journal capability to publish detached exact observation bytes before delegating those bytes and the same owned candidate view to the audited signer. The operational CLI uses a no-replace hard-link journal and can recover the exact plan-scoped sign-once result without a new TLS connection. This blocks the observation-to-attestation crash window and known sibling or incomplete candidate views without claiming unseen-global completeness, physical topology, or absolute Sybil authority.

Synchronously owns the bounded ceremony bundle, nonce, time, timeout, and either both dedicated possession tokens or an explicit null legacy mode; restores the signed endpoint binding, requires both advertised origins to be HTTPS, and starts both captured probes before its first suspension. The default probes require platform-verified TLS and a bounded role-key signature over the ceremony, role, origin, observer nonce, time, and same-connection TLS exporter digest. A captured proof replayed under the same certificate on a new TLS connection fails. Explicit legacy mode retains identity-only v1 without promotion; every artifact remains non-authoritative and keeps administration and failure-domain independence unproven.

Synchronously owns and restores the bounded source-verdict bytes, validates the deployment-plan ID, snapshots the signer identity and method, and derives the complete immutable ratification content, ID, signature message, and deployment-plan-keyed durable sign-once tuple before suspension. It invokes only the captured signer method and then verifies the returned key and Ed25519 signature. The closure verifier separately requires one exact ratification from every unique role key derived from the fully reverified execution-receipt set, preventing two complete participant closures for the same deployment plan under conforming durable signers.

Synchronously snapshots the signer capability, owns the bounded artifact bytes, validates the exact source commit, artifact identity, kind, and role, and derives the complete immutable receipt content, ID, signature message, and artifact-keyed durable sign-once tuple before suspension. It invokes only the captured signer method, then validates the returned key and Ed25519 signature before returning detached canonical bytes. The aggregate verifier separately binds the receipt to the authenticated signer and artifact in the complete public pilot chain.

Synchronously owns and restores the exact bounded self-hashed profile bytes and absolute state path before suspension, then uses one same-directory no-replace hard-link publication to lock role, trust root, policy, key ID, and advertised origin. Exact retry restores byte-identical state; a competing profile fails closed and crash-left pending files never become the selected profile.

Synchronously owns and canonically restores the bounded request, checks the configured trust root, root-bound local policy, signer identity, signer-local advertised-origin binding, and in-process challenge slot, then delegates only an owned role-separated message plus deterministic slot tuple to the constructor-captured private signer; the imported exact challenge verifier and its module are digest-pinned, and a durable authority can enforce the same tuple across process races and restart before detached canonical response bytes return.

Synchronously owns and canonically restores a bounded observer nonce, ceremony, role, key, instant, and exact configured endpoint challenge plus one fixed-size TLS exporter derived by the native TLS service on that same request connection. It binds the exporter digest into a domain-separated proof ID, delegates only the owned proof message and deterministic proof tuple to the constructor-captured role signer before suspension, then returns detached canonical bytes. A replayed proof on a new TLS connection has another exporter and fails observer verification; the separate possession token bounds access and grants no admission signature authority.

Synchronously owns exact Capsule/generation/idempotency input, restores a canonical durable result, competes for one completion-keyed no-replace owner claim before invoking the captured Continuity capability, and atomically publishes returned Capsule/commit bytes; unresolved winners remain fail-closed.

Synchronously owns the exact effect request, restores any canonical durable result, competes for one predecessor/effect-keyed no-replace owner claim before invoking the captured provider capability, and atomically publishes a newly returned result; unresolved winners remain fail-closed.

Invokes constructor-captured baseline and range capabilities, verifies canonical relay frames into a monotonic private cursor, and contributes only owned deduplicated liveness-response payload bytes to a detached evidence snapshot.

Synchronously rederives the committed repair effect, requires exact canonical outer and encoded-placement result schemas, snapshots the successor placement set, creates one proved successor generation with no liveness evidence or epoch sidecars, and claims one completion slot bound to the immutable repair slot, prior commit, manifest, and successor generation before delegating owned generation bytes plus a deterministic candidate idempotency key to the private Continuity session.
